newsitem.title: USA: Brush Creek discovers visible gold.
newsitem.headline: Brush Creek discovers visible gold.

text.p: Brush Creek Mining and Development Co Inc said it has encountered visible gold within quartz at the 270 foot level of its Wolf Vein.
Brush Creek said it has begun tests at the most promising point of the vein and has encountered an increase in the intensit of gold within the ribbon quartz.
"This increases the likelihood that we may be entering an economic pocket of higher grade gold," Kenneth Friedman, a mining analyst, said in Brush Creek's statement.
